RESOLVED: Dear Dana, 

I've reviewed your claim CLM-550193 for the brain MRI on August 27. The denial reason was "prior authorization not on file". You may file a first-level appeal within 180 days of the denial notice date. Your ordering provider, Dr. L. Okonjo, may submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting medical necessity. 

The exact deadline for your appeal is 180 days from the denial notice date. I've attached the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) for your reference. If you have any questions or need further assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out. 

Please note that standard appeals are decided within 30 calendar days. 

Sincerely,
ARIA, Meridian Health Plan Member Services
